title: Bubbles
copy: Stop swapping numbers around the table. Bubbles is a shareable contact list for events and group gatherings — one link to collect everyone, export as vCards when you're done.

title: Care Plans
copy: Dynamic treatment planning inside Forward's member app. I helped shape a single flow that met patients wherever they were — guided pathways for anyone who just wanted a clear next step, and deeper customization for the people who preferred to steer their own care.

title: Full Body Diagnostic
copy: A self-serve physical inside the Forward CarePod. Step in, run your own blood draw and scans, and watch the results resolve in real time while a clinician reviews remotely — walking out with a full diagnostic and a care plan tailored on the spot.

title: Null Wines
copy: Brand, digital, and creative consulting for a startup non-alcoholic wine brand. In a matter of weeks, did an evaulation of the brand, it's values, opinions, tone, and mannerisms, and created packaging inserts, press material, and a webstore nullwines.com.

title: Villa Sul Lago, Giuseppe Terragni
copy: A studio analysis of Giuseppe Terragni's unbuilt 1936 Villa sul Lago — a Rationalist "house for the artist" on the shore of Lake Como. I rebuilt and dissected the scheme: the living spaces lifted into a clean prism on piloti, the service functions (kitchen, laundry, storage) expelled from the pure volume, and a facade whose openings set up a deliberately asymmetric rhythm across the water. A study in how Terragni made abstraction structural.
